app.title: AIO – All-in-One
settings.title: Settings
help.display: If Chinese, Japanese or Hindi characters appear as boxes, your terminal font lacks those glyphs. In Termux, install a font with wide Unicode coverage via the Termux:Styling add-on, or copy a font to ~/.termux/font.ttf and run termux-reload-settings. Arabic and Hebrew are right-aligned; how letters are joined depends on your terminal.
